ue2c30bb2ef: Wiring with an LDO voltage conversion circuit
u98ed866283: As shown in ⟦1⟧Wiring reference for a programming socket or device⟦/1⟧, the programming socket has an LDO voltage conversion circuit: the LDO hardware circuit converts the "6.5V" pin of the programmer pin header to the programming voltage required by the chip, such as 5V or 4.2V, and the programmer controls the power supply to the chip by switching the LDO supply on and off through the ⟦2⟧3.3V header⟦/2⟧ pin. The connections between the programmer header pins and the chip programming pins are as follows:
u1cc94bc248: 6.5V (the LDO conversion top board converts 6.5V to 5V, 4.2V, etc.)
ufcb53aeeb1: DM (some chips have no DM and use another pin)
u60e5ddcb38: DP (some chips have no DP and use another pin)
ue5cd2b0156: Wiring with the chip supply voltage output directly from the programmer's power pin
ub0b7fb6c91: As shown in ⟦1⟧Wiring reference for a programming socket or device⟦/1⟧, ignore the ⟦2⟧LDO⟦/2⟧ part when wiring. The "6.5V" pin of the programmer pin header directly outputs the programming voltage required by the chip as configured in the PC tool, such as 5V or 4.2V. The connections between the programmer header pins and the chip programming pins are as follows:
u1470cf68ca: 6.5V (the programmer directly outputs the programming voltage⟦1/⟧configured in the PC tool, such as 5V or 4.2V)
u88d28e9a3d: Programming sockets used to have an LDO conversion circuit because it was expected that some uncalibrated chips might reach customers and would then have to be calibrated by the programmer, or because programming the efuse storage medium of some chips requires specific voltages such as 6.5V or 3.3V;
ub29c96c7b2: The current programmer has a chip calibration check function: if a chip is not calibrated, programming reports an error! In addition, programming the efuse-related key, lvd, etc. no longer requires specific voltages;
uc02685e5bd: The LDO circuit can be removed from the programming socket, and the socket can be built as a minimum chip system for programming! This makes the programming socket simpler, saves materials and allows it to be used as a universal programming socket;
u91d359e4ce: Powering the chip through an LDO conversion circuit also has advantages: shorter traces, a relatively more stable power supply and possibly a higher programming pass rate;
u9fc52156eb: With firmware version V2.27.9 or later, the 1-to-2 programmer allows the programming socket supply voltage to be configured in the PC tool within "4.2V~6.8V". There are three main use cases:
u8b457c43c7: ⟦1⟧Without an LDO circuit⟦/1⟧: the "6.5V" pin of the programmer pin header directly outputs the voltage configured in the PC tool, such as 5V or 4.2V, to the chip's VBAT supply pin. ⟦2/⟧ ⟦3/⟧
u6b6705672a: ⟦1⟧With an LDO voltage conversion circuit⟦/1⟧: a hardware circuit converts the 6.5V from the programmer pin header to the supply voltage required by the chip, such as 5V or 4.2V; the supply voltage must be set to "Default". ⟦2/⟧ ⟦3/⟧
uf710e0936e: Low-voltage programming supply, for example when IOVDD and VBAT are tied together: VBAT can be connected directly to the 3.3V pin of the programmer pin header, or the 6.5V from the programmer pin header can be converted to the supply voltage required by the chip.

ua45c6513c1: 1. Configure the "Power consumption test (uA): xxx" (功耗测试(uA):xxx) option;
u2959a518b9: 2. The test is off by default: select OFF to skip the soft power-off power consumption test;
uf566c890f3: 3. To enable the test, enter a specific value, for example "10": the chip then undergoes the soft power-off power consumption test, and if the measured value is greater than 10uA, programming reports an error and the chip is treated as defective;

u8d7a798e4f: The Jieli 1-to-8 programmer (also commonly called a burner or programmer) is mainly used for offline programming (no connection to a PC is needed during programming) of firmware into chips already mounted on devices.
ub331cc8ba4: During development, one programmer can program the firmware of 1 to 8 device chips; in mass production, combined with programming fixtures, N programmers can program N*8 device chips simultaneously, either manually or automatically.
u0114bb9175: The main functions of the 1-to-8 programmer are:
u09936a152b: Firmware programming (supports programming internal/external flash, and programming/upgrading with a battery attached)
udc0ad225a9: Main power supply port of the programmer
ue7ff0e605c: Lights up when power is supplied and the main power switch is turned on
